documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a 3% increase in reported revenues for FY19 (13% on an adjusted basis) alongside a significant expansion in international revenues, which crossed the $20 million milestone. Gross and EBITDA margins improved year-on-year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and tight cost controls, despite pressures from severe weather in core domestic markets during Q4 and rising staff expenses. For FY20, management guided for ongoing capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore, plans for domestic sales outlet and distributor additions, and potential price increases in the second half if milk prices remain high. Vadilal Industries reported robust revenue and margin expansion during Q3 and the first nine months of FY19, driven by strong growth in both domestic and international segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double-digit growth with a higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates another positive year in FY20 by leveraging the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business consumption was impacted in Q4 by exceptionally severe weather conditions and an extended winter.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues grew by 54% in FY19 and crossed the $20 million milestone driven by strong demand from the Indian diaspora.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double-digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth, which was temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong demand pull for ice cream and processed foods from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company maintained a positive business outlook due to a better consumption environment, demand shift to the organized sector, and continued international traction.
demand_outlook.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY 19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and higher realization international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, driven largely by U.S. operations.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: Other operating expenses were kept under tight control and remained almost unchanged.
margins_costs.quote: However, we have kept a tight control on other operating expenses that remained almost unchanged.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued for the next season, which is expected to benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity was expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Bareilly facility has an ice cream capacity of 150,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005

orders_capacity.claim: Dharampur facility has a processed foods capacity of 33,000 kgs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

orders_capacity.claim: Pundhra facility has an ice cream capacity of 230,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

capital_allocation.claim: Outstanding debt was reconstituted to increase long-tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic ice cream consumption in core markets was negatively impacted in Q4 by severe weather and an extended winter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to certain risks and uncertainties like regulatory changes, local political or economic developments, and many other factors.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward- looking statements are subject to certain risks and uncertainties, like regulatory changes, local political or economic developments, and many other factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from those contemplated by the relevant forward-looking statements.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Prices will be looked to be increased in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.
